_what: What kind of file a file field (FileField.tsx) takes, as DATA. A form input names one of `takes` by id (a Workshop tool's screen says `"file": { "takes": "video" }` on the input); `accept` lists the media types it takes (`type/*` is every type under `type/`, an empty list takes any file), used both to filter the person's files in the chooser and to guard what is dropped or uploaded; `noun` is the word the field uses for one such file. A file with no media type is known by the ending of its name through the shared file chip's endings (parts/ui/show/file-chip/file-kinds.json). `words` are every sentence the field says, `{noun}` and `{name}` filled in. A new kind of file is one row in `takes`.

words.drop: Drop a {noun} here, or click to upload one
words.failed: This folder could not be read
words.not_taken: That is not a {noun}. Choose a {noun} instead.
words.upload_failed: {name} could not be uploaded. Try again.
words.drop_many: Drop files here, or click to upload
